facts.value: An application without a completed bachelor's degree is possible if at least 80% of the required credits in the bachelor's program have been completed at the time of application.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: If you have not yet completed your bachelor's degree, please apply with the following additional application documents by May 15: proof of enrollment in the bachelor's program and a provisional certificate that includes an average grade and all previous examination results.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: If a bachelor's degree certificate is not yet available, only provisional admission can be granted subject to successful completion of the bachelor's degree. The bachelor's degree certificate must be submitted by the end of the first semester of the master's program for final admission.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: All required courses for the bachelor's degree should preferably be completed in the summer semester preceding the master's program to ensure a successful start in the master's study.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Even if you completed your degree at a university outside Germany, an online application through the Uni Assist portal is sufficient.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: For applications to a higher semester, an application for credit transfer and a transcript of earned credits must also be submitted.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Application deadline for January 15 for classification into the 2nd or 4th semester and for May 15 for classification into the 3rd semester.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Admission to a higher semester can only occur if open study places are available and the corresponding ECTS credits for transfer are available.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: For up to 30 ECTS, classification into the 2nd semester; for 31 to 60 ECTS, classification into the 3rd semester; for 61 to 90 ECTS, classification into the 4th semester.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: If there are more applications than available places for a higher semester, a ranking will be created according to the applicable selection regulations.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy
